title: British Museum collection record for Benin plaque Af1913,1211.1
author: British Museum

notes.text: Verified against web-indexed official catalogue text on 3 October 2026 for A Short History of Taking Things and Keeping Them. Relevant locators: Acquisition name; Acquisition date; Acquisition notes. The catalogue records a Foreign Office donation in 1913 and quotes a register describing two Benin plaques as samples sent after the punitive expedition. Its narrative explicitly acknowledges looting by British soldiers in 1897. The forty-two-item accession group includes other African material: the note associates only its first two entries with the Benin plaques. Do not describe all forty-two as Benin loot or confuse the accession year with the removal year. This documentary registration does not create a new object or claim. Direct web retrieval returned HTTP 403; indexed official text was usable. No complete-page redistribution licence or publishable image has been established, so no full capture or image is registered.
